title: fix: Veo defaults to landscape and bills audio only when requested
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Two Veo bugs, both on the Vertex primary and the Replicate fallback:

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Default orientation | The gateway always fills 1024×1024, which Veo's ratio helper mapped to **9:16**; `aspectRatio` was ignored unless width/height were also sent | Explicit `aspectRatio` wins; otherwise caller-set dimensions pick the orientation; square or omitted dimensions default to **16:9** |
| Omitted `audio` | Runtime default was `true`, so Veo generated and billed audio (+$0.02/s) although the docs and code said it was off | Veo generates and bills audio only with `audio=true` |

- `audio` now stays unset when omitted, so each model applies its own default. Seedance 2.0/2.5, wan-3.0 and the Alibaba wan route keep audio on by default via an explicit `?? true` (their price doesn't change with audio).
- Docs: `audio` no longer claims `default(false)` for every model. It now lists which models honor `audio=false` (Seedance 2.0 family, Seedance 2.5, wan-3.0), which always generate audio (wan2.6, wan-2.7, grok-imagine-video-1.5, gemini-omni, MiniMax H3 family), and Veo's opt-in. Veo is added to the models that default to 16:9.
- Cache: adds an optional registry `cacheVersion` that the media cache key includes, and sets it on Veo, so URLs cached under the old portrait-with-audio defaults generate fresh instead of replaying the old video.

**Local E2E through gen:**

| Request | Output | Audio | Billed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Veo, no params | 1280×720 | none | 0.32 (4s video) |
| Veo `aspectRatio=9:16&audio=true` | 720×1280 | aac | 0.40 (+0.08 audio) |
| seedance-2.0-fast, `audio` omitted | 864×496 | aac (unchanged) | 0.28 |

Pack balance moved by exactly 1.00 = sum of the three events.

Cache: the same Veo URL generated on `main` (720×1280, audio, 0.40) and then on this branch produced a fresh 1280×720 video without audio (0.32) instead of the cached one; the repeat request hit the new entry.

Tests: gen image suite, docs/OpenAPI and fallback tests (821), typec

gist.headline: Veo finds the wide angle
gist.blurb: Veo stops treating a square default as a request for portrait video. It also leaves the soundtrack—and its bill—out unless asked.
gist.summary: Veo honors explicit aspectRatio, uses caller-set dimensions for orientation, defaults to 16:9 when dimensions are square or omitted, and generates audio only with audio=true; a cache version prevents old portrait-with-audio results from being replayed.
gist.impact: A default four-second Veo request produces 1280×720 video without audio at 0.32 instead of portrait video with audio at 0.40; other video models retain their existing audio defaults.
gist.visual_concept: Veo is a video model, not a mascot: show a little retro video monitor displaying a wide 16:9 landscape, with a separate, unselected music-note button. Polli adjusts the monitor while a vine curls around it; a fresh film frame beside the screen hints that old cached results are replaced.
